title: Order drop, Hecke descent, and a mod $p^4$ supercongruence for symmetric-cube hypergeometric coefficients
summary: We prove that the symmetric-cube coefficients $A_n=(-27)^n[z^n]\,_2F_1(1/3,1/3;1;z)^3$ satisfy the supercongruence $A(mp)\equiv A(m) \bmod p^4$ for every prime $p\geq 5$ and every $m\geq 1$.
